title: Where the kinetic energy goes when trolleys stick
caption: Momentum is conserved (2 × 3 = 3 × 2), so the joined trolleys move at 2.0 m s⁻¹. Energy is conserved too, but not as kinetic energy: of the 9.0 J before, 6.0 J is still kinetic and 3.0 J becomes heat and sound.
alt: Energy flow diagram: 9.0 J of kinetic energy before the collision splits into 6.0 J of kinetic energy after and 3.0 J of heat and sound.
description: Before: a 2 kg trolley at 3 m s⁻¹ has kinetic energy ½ × 2 × 3² = 9.0 J; the 1 kg trolley is at rest.
Momentum: 2 × 3 = 3.0 v, so v = 2.0 m s⁻¹ after they stick.
After: ½ × 3 × 2² = 6.0 J of kinetic energy, the band that carries straight on.
The other 3.0 J turns down as heat and sound. The widths add up: energy is conserved even though kinetic energy is not.
